title: Act: Build scene objects in BootScene.create via buildScene
summary: Export sceneSpec and call buildScene from BootScene
description: Add a validated sceneSpec export to runtime/content.ts and make BootScene.create build objects through buildScene with the Phaser render context, destroying them on shutdown.
definition_of_done: BootScene holds sceneObjects built from content only

steps.action: Import sceneSchema and type SceneSpec from '@game/content/schema' and add an exported constant parsed from the same bedroom.yaml.

Import buildScene from '@game/engine/buildScene', SceneObject type from '@game/entities/SceneObject', createPhaserRenderContext from './renderContext', and sceneSpec from '../runtime/content'. Add field private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = [];

After this.effects = buildEffects(ctx, scene), add this.sceneObjects = buildScene(createPhaserRenderContext(this, (id) => this.resolveKey(id)), sceneSpec). In the SHUTDOWN callback add this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.destroy()); this.sceneObjects = [].
steps.expected: Objects are built from content and destroyed on shutdown
